failure.linux: Prism's player needs libmpv. Install it from your package manager (e.g. libmpv2), then reopen the player.

failure.bug: This is a problem in Prism, not in your video or your installation. Check Settings → General → Updates for a newer version. If it keeps happening, Settings → Privacy & advanced → Diagnostics → Export logs gives you a file to attach to a bug report.
